additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431854-DC/Si-D/IT- [ MP / R9 170002654] METER not working CRM:02832000096
additional_info.body:
Hello Luca,
Hope you are doing well.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0431854 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
IT
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Based on the reported issue, I have checked the logs for the last day, but I could not find any error related to the DC meter. Additionally, the charger is showing healthy on SCB and no active error flags.
However, there are indications of a communication issue between the SECC lite and PLC
Please plan a site visit to check the Ecog Lite (KF12) connections and 24V input supply.
Check the ethernet connections from KF12 to the switch.
Keep one spare KF12 (SECC Charge Controller 1x CCS2 > 8EM5903-0AA00-5AA6) with you, in case a replacement is required.
If the DC meter issue still persists, need to check the followings-
Proper connection of the data link cable on both the Meter Unit and Sensor Unit
Integrity and correct pairing of the Meter and Sensor Units
Physical condition of the cable and connectors
Presence of any tampering or environmental/environmental damage (e.g., corrosion, moisture)
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
X
End Customer Communication
X
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
IT
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Beerpal Singh

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431854-DC/Si-D/IT- [ MP / R9 170002654] METER not working CRM:02832000096
additional_info.body:
Ciao Beerpal,
Today we were on site to perform what you wrote in the ticket.
We checked KF11 (KF12 mentioned by you was not present. You can also confirm it from the schematics in SCB). We found 24V and ethernet connection was properly working.
After that, we moved on in the bottom door area to check BC5 that was found off. So we checked all the connection from QA1 to BC5 passing through FC5 and FB1. We found out that there was not any current/tension. Continuity was found in every components.
How can we proceed? What else can we check?
Thank you.
With best regards,
Matteo MALACRIDA
